summary: Crouton Alpha is a stealth model that is free on OpenCode Zen for a limited time. Announced by @opencode on 2026-11-03 as "free for the next week" (through ~2026-11-10), with 1M context, multi-modal input, and no training on data. The free period is limited to certain regions. OpenCode's Zen model list shows id crouton-alpha-free at $0 input, output, and cached reads.
claim_steps: Sign in to OpenCode Zen at opencode.ai/zen and copy your API key.
In the OpenCode TUI, run /connect, select OpenCode Zen, and paste your API key.
Run /models and select Crouton Alpha Free (model id: crouton-alpha-free).
Availability is limited to certain regions.
